### Si5338, Si5335, Si5334, Si5356A/B Errata

### Errata Status Summary



| Errata# | Title | Impact | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | CMOS(in-phase) format output high impedance | Minor | May be fixed in a future revision. |

Impact definition: Each erratum is marked with an impact, as defined below:

Minor-Workaround exists.

● Major-Errata that do not conform to the data sheet or standard.

● Information-The device behavior is not ideal but acceptable. Typically, the data sheet will be changed to match the device behavior.

### Errata Details

### Description:

When the output driver banks are configured for CMOS(in-phase) mode, the typical output impedance of the driver is 55 Q versus the typical 50 Q as stated in the data sheet.

Note: For CMOS single-output and CMOS(complimentary) modes, the output impedance is 50  $\Omega$  as stated in the data sheet.

### Impact:

The slightly higher output impedance is generally not an issue when driving traces with 50 Q characteristic impedance. If driving a trace with a lower than 50Ω impedance, or you think this could impact your application's performance, then the below workarounds should be considered.

### Workarounds:

1. Use the CMOS complimentary mode instead of the CMOS in-phase format mode.

2. Adjust the trace impedance to 55 Q.

3. The device does have programmable registers that may be used to adjust the output impedance. Contact the Silicon Labs factory technical support for assistance with this option.

### Resolution:

This limitation may be fixed in a future revision.
